info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Mortgage Loans Documents-v1-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loan Document Retrieval API allows users to access and list documents associated with mortgage loans. This endpoint serves as a crucial resource for financial institutions, mortgage brokers, and loan officers who need to retrieve relevant documentation for processing applications or audits. By providing quick access to essential documents, this API supports efficient decision-making and compliance within the mortgage industry. Typical use cases include retrieving loan documents for reviews or integrating document data into existing systems.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch documents associated with loans. It is useful for obtaining detailed information about each loan's documentation, ensuring compliance and record-keeping.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving loan documents. This request expects the required parameters in JSON format to successfully fetch the document details associated with loans.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of loan documents.

ListMortgageLoansDocumentsRequest.description: This schema represents the expected request body for the GET operation in the Loans and Documents API.

ListMortgageLoansDocumentsResponse_200.title: Loan Document Response

status.description: Indicates the success status of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the loan document.

resultId.description: Unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the loan document.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional details about the operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the loan document.

ListMortgageLoansDocumentsResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for a successful GET operation on loan documents.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the loan document.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the loan document was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the loan document was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema containing audit details for loan documents.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
